name: export-pdf
description: Export the front Keynote document as a PDF to /tmp

steps.script:
tell application "Keynote"
    tell front document
        export to POSIX file "/tmp/keynote-export.pdf" as PDF
    end tell
    return "Exported to /tmp/keynote-export.pdf"
end tell
steps.description:
AppleScript: tell application "Keynote"
    tell front document
        export to POSIX file ...
